description: This file defines a React component for an admin configuration page in a manufacturing defect management system. It allows users to create and list defect types, production lines, and shifts, and includes a seed function to populate initial data.

methods.name: asStr
methods.description: Utility function to convert unknown values to string, handling null and undefined.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches defect types, production lines, and shifts from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: quickSeed
methods.description: Seeds the system with a minimal set of defect types, production lines, and shifts for quick setup.
